items.stem: Summarize the main ways the United States responded to post-WWII global challenges between 1945-1950.
items.stemEs: Resuma las principales formas en que Estados Unidos respondió a desafíos globales post-Segunda Guerra Mundial entre 1945-1950.

choices.text: Economic stability would make nations less vulnerable to communist pressure and influence
choices.textEs: Se enfocó exclusivamente en intervención militar sin proporcionar ninguna ayuda económica

choices.text: It committed the U.S. to actively intervening globally to support threatened free nations
choices.textEs: Regresó a aislacionismo de preguerra evitando todo involucramiento en asuntos internacionales

choices.text: Created the UN, provided Marshall Plan aid, formed NATO alliance, and intervened in Korea
choices.textEs: Creó la ONU, proporcionó ayuda del Plan Marshall, formó alianza OTAN e intervino en Corea

choices.text: As president, he had authority to commit U.S. resources and set foreign policy direction
choices.textEs: Negoció tratados aceptando control comunista tanto de Europa Occidental como Oriental

items.explanation: Created the UN, provided Marshall Plan aid, formed NATO alliance, and intervened in Korea. The United States sent billions of dollars to rebuild Western Europe and strengthen it against communist influence. B is incorrect because it describes a different program, event, or idea than this Cold War development. It shaped the early Cold War and the postwar order the United States helped build after 1945.
items.explanationEs: Resumen de respuesta de EE.UU. incluye: institucional (fundación ONU), económico (Plan Marshall), alianza militar (OTAN) e intervención directa (Corea) - mostrando enfoque internacionalista integral a contención.
